AdaptiveQuizItem.description:
gb_adaptive_quiz — the same answer_spec contract as boss questions.

Production fixtures use `q`, but the tutor leak test uses `prompt` with
nested option/field/rubric blocks. Both must validate.
AdaptiveQuizItem.title: AdaptiveQuizItem

AnswerSpec.title: AnswerSpec

BossAntiCheatPolicy.description: Anti-cheat signal fields. Schema-only in v1; runtime telemetry deferred.
BossAntiCheatPolicy.title: BossAntiCheatPolicy

BossMeta.description:
Optional metadata block for the boss phase.

All fields optional. Lives under content_json.boss_meta — never required.
Existing homeworks without boss_meta render unchanged.
BossMeta.title: BossMeta

FlashcardItem.description: Each fixture uses {term, def, cluster}. NB: key is `def`, not `definition`.
FlashcardItem.title: FlashcardItem

MemoryPalace.description: A single palace (route) that students can walk during encoding.
MemoryPalace.title: MemoryPalace

MemoryPalaceConcept.description: One concept to be encoded and recalled via the palace route.
MemoryPalaceConcept.title: MemoryPalaceConcept

MemoryPalaceConfig.description:
Authored config overrides for the Memory Palace game-break.

All fields are optional; server-side defaults fill any omitted keys.
See _MP_DEFAULTS in server/services/injector.py.
MemoryPalaceConfig.title: MemoryPalaceConfig

MemoryPalaceGame.description:
Top-level container stored in content_json.gb_memory_palace.

Holds the authored palace routes + concepts for the game-break.
Validators enforce structural integrity when content is present;
empty arrays are allowed during builder authoring.
MemoryPalaceGame.title: MemoryPalaceGame

MemoryPalaceLocation.description: A single station inside a Memory Palace route.
MemoryPalaceLocation.title: MemoryPalaceLocation

MemorySprintItem.description: Question types observed: KO (multi-choice), TF (true/false), YNNG (yes/no/unknown).
MemorySprintItem.title: MemorySprintItem

PuzzleLockItem.description:
gb_puzzle_lock — tile + Q&A. Legacy variants use {text, question, answer}
instead of {content, q, a}, so all six keys are optional.
PuzzleLockItem.title: PuzzleLockItem

RLCConceptChip.description: A concept chip for the concept-select step.
RLCConceptChip.title: RLCConceptChip

RLCConsequence.description: Post-decision ripple node (deferred runtime visual; schema-ready).
RLCConsequence.title: RLCConsequence

RLCDecisionOption.description: A single MC option on a decision step.
RLCDecisionOption.title: RLCDecisionOption

RLCStakeholder.description: Character in the case (deferred runtime visual; schema-ready).
RLCStakeholder.title: RLCStakeholder

RLCStep.description: One of the 5 steps in the case flow.
RLCStep.title: RLCStep

RealLifeField.description: A single fill-in field inside a real_life q with `fields`.
RealLifeField.title: RealLifeField

RealLifePhase.description:
Top-level scenario block. Every q1..qN slot is optional — fixtures
contain anywhere from 1 to 6+ questions.
RealLifePhase.title: RealLifePhase

RealLifeQuestion.description:
Fixtures show 3 shapes:
  - {prompt, ans, fb}                     — single text answer
  - {prompt, fields: [...], fb}           — multiple labeled blanks
  - {prompt, open: true, fb}              — open-ended (graded by AI)
All combinations exist; we accept all.
RealLifeQuestion.title: RealLifeQuestion

SentenceFillItem.description: gb_sentence_fill — cloze passage with per-blank answers + optional word bank.
SentenceFillItem.title: SentenceFillItem

TileMatchPair.description:
gb_tile_match — structured pair for the Tile Match game.

Each instance represents one left/right concept pair. The injector splits
these into a side-disjoint flat array so the client never sees both sides
of a pair in the same JS object (answer-leak prevention).
TileMatchPair.title: TileMatchPair

TttConfig.description:
gb_ttt_config — optional XP and session overrides for the TTT game.

All fields are optional; the injector applies spec defaults when absent:
  session_games=3, xp_correct=50, xp_draw=200, xp_win=300,
  xp_strong_session=100, xp_mercy=10, mercy_chance=0.002.
TttConfig.title: TttConfig

TttItem.description:
gb_ttt — tic-tac-toe quiz with {id, q, correct, distractors[]} (3 distractors).

`id` is optional (auto-assigned by the injector as "ttt-1", "ttt-2", ... if absent).
`correct` and `distractors` are server-only — stripped by the injector before the
wire format is sent to the client (side-disjoint, answer-leak prevention).
TttItem.title: TttItem

description:
Full `content_json` blob. Every phase is optional and `extra='allow'`
is set on every nested model, so unknown keys propagate untouched. The
boundary validator only rejects shapes that are *obviously* wrong (e.g.,
`flashcards` set to a string instead of a list, `meta` set to a list).
title: ContentJSON
